data.title: Natura
data.about:
Discover the essence of modern living intertwined with nature's charm at Damac Natura Townhouses. Inspired by timeless landscapes while focusing on the future, these 4-bedroom townhouses symbolize the blend of an aspirational lifestyle with a profound appreciation for the natural world. 

Natura by DAMAC embodies elegance and functionality, where every detail is crafted to elevate natural living. Experience a home where sophistication meets practicality, featuring private gardens on the ground floor and expansive rooftops, ideal for families. Natura Townhouses invite you to see life through a new lens, filled with excitement and adventure.

This new release by Damac are nestled in the vibrant community of Natura at Damac Hills 2, offering an unparalleled lifestyle of luxury and family-oriented fun. Damac Hills 2 is a haven of entertainment, home to Water Town with attractions like Malibu Beach, wave pools, splash pads, and thrilling slides. For those seeking relaxation, the lazy river offers a peaceful retreat. With Damac Natura Townhouses for sale, you're not just buying a home; you're embracing a lifestyle where every day is an adventure, promising a community experience unlike any other.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points

• Luxurious Living: Offers premium 4-bedroom townhouses, combining elegance and sophistication.

  • Strategic Location: Short drive from the heart of Dubai with easy access to major highways and transportation networks.
  • Vibrant Community: Features amenities like Malibu Beach and Paintball Park for leisure and adventure.
  • Convenience at Doorstep: Supermarkets, cafes, and a medical center are just minutes away from Damac Natura.
  • Seamless Design: Modern Natura townhouses with balconies and terraces, blending indoor and outdoor spaces.
  • Panoramic Views: Damac Natura Townhouses Offers residents breathtaking views in a peaceful setting.
  • Accessibility: Ensures seamless connectivity to Dubai’s key destinations.
  • Investment Opportunity: Represents an unmatched opportunity in Dubai’s real estate market.

location_tile.title: Easy Accessibility at Natura Damac Hills 2
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Discover a commute that transforms your journey back to a serene sanctuary, ensuring you arrive home swiftly. The Natura by DAMAC development is perfectly situated to offer you seamless connectivity, with direct access to four central highways and a multitude of transport options. A simple 25-minute drive on Al Qudra Road brings you to the gates of DAMAC Hills 2, where the DAMAC Natura Townhouses await, offering an unparalleled living experience.

DAMAC Hills 2, in the heart of Dubai, is a prestigious residential hub known for its Natura Townhouses. This new release by DAMAC is a haven of luxury, comfort, and convenience, set amidst lush green landscapes. It's not just a place to live; it's a lifestyle promise that blends modern urban living with nature. Being in close proximity to major road networks, the Natura Townhouses for sale offer easy access to the city's prime destinations.

  • 15 Mins to Damac Hills
  • 25 Mins to Global Village
  • 25 Mins to IMG World of Adventures
  • 25 Mins to Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 30 Mins Al Maktoum Airport
  • 35 Mins to Dubai International Airport
